_about: THE album queue (Tiffany Nov 11 2:27pm: full queue, visual calendar by week, readiness columns that get everything done). One album per Mon-Sun week. 'week' = the Monday; 'proposed' until she OKs the week, then it is copied into config/album-launch-slots.json (album_gate --golive [10c] reads that). Readiness is COMPUTED by scripts/albumreview/album_calendar.py from the album record, album_gate.py and the live site: nothing on the calendar can be ticked by hand. Sources: docs/plans/album-calendar.md, her Nov 11 lineup calls (docs/ANSWERS.md 12:31-2:17pm), release-calendar.json.
